headlines.title: Nick Reiner prosecutors won’t seek death penalty in the killing of parents Rob and Michele Reiner, DA says
headlines.description: LOS ANGELES — Prosecutors will not seek the death penalty against Nick Reiner, charged with murder in the killings of his parents Rob and Michelle Reiner, after consulting with the victims’ loved ones, officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: DHS watchdog report finds detainees were held in outdoor cages at 'Alligator Alcatraz'
headlines.description: A DHS watchdog report includes new photos of cages and that they were used to confine detainees at the immigration facility known as "Alligator Alcatraz." NBC News’ Julia Ainsley reports.

headlines.title: Head of CFDA takes leave after physically restraining PETA protesters
headlines.description: A confrontation between PETA activists and Steven Kolb, the head of the Council of Fashion Designers of America, erupted on the runway during New York Fashion Week. NBC News' Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: Crane collapses onto cars in Miami
headlines.description: A crane collapse sparked a fiery scene as crews raced to search for survivors. Thick smoke billowed from the mangled wreck. Officials say four people suffered minor injuries. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch is there.

headlines.title: Candidate for Wisconsin Governor survives emergency plane landing
headlines.description: On a small plane ride home after a campaign event, Congressman Tom Tiffany, the Republican nominee for Governor, found himself in a lake with minor injuries after the plane he was on lost power and was forced to make an emergency landing. NBC News’ Tom Costello reports.

headlines.title: Live: Early October Prime Day deals just dropped — I found 31+ worth shopping
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days starts on October 6, but early deals are already live. Shop products at least 20% off from Dyson, Garmin, Ninja and more.

headlines.title: It’s almost dry skin season — here’s what to look for in a body lotion
headlines.description: These expert-recommended moisturizers can help your skin stay hydrated and healthy. Shop the best body lotions for dry skin from brands like CeraVe, La Roche-Posay and more.

headlines.title: What is tranexamic acid? Everything derms want you to know about the under-the-radar brightening ingredient
headlines.description: Tranexamic acid serum is good for melasma and dark spots. Dermatologists recommend tranexamic acid serum from brands like SkinMedica, Glow Recipe and Paula’s Choice.

headlines.title: October Prime Day dates were just announced — here’s everything you need to know
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days is Amazon’s second Prime Day-level sale of 2026 for loyalty members. These are the dates and details to know, plus what to expect.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania man charged in plot to assist ISIS in terror attack, feds say
headlines.description: A Pennsylvania man with a history of plotting a mass-casualty attack as a minor was charged on Tuesday with obtaining a semiautomatic rifle to carry out an attack for ISIS after he discussed strategies to target non-Muslims, according to court documents.

headlines.title: His coach thinks he will be the best quarterback ever. He has a long way to go.
headlines.description: Los Angeles Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh was not shy when discussing his expectations for starting quarterback Justin Herbert before the season, opting instead to make a very specific — and very bold — claim.
